BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
SHANGHAI
16th July, 1985
22 7 45

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I enclose herein a copy of a letter we
have received from Mrs. Evelyn Danforth, 243 Water
Street, Gardiner Main, U.S.A., enquiring as to the
present whereabouts of a Mr./Terrance Down.
Richard

According to the records of our Consulate-
General there is a Mr. Richard Terence Down, born
Bristol, England, on the 17th March 1999, who was
last registered here on the 5th December 1929. He
appears, however, to have been in Shanghai in 1938 as
there is mention of the question of his non-registra-
tion for the years 1930/1938, but he does not appear
to have registered. His last address was c/o
Anderson, Meyer & Company, Limited, 8 Yuen Ming Yuen
Road, Shanghai.

Can you please assist me in ascertaining
whether he is still in Shanghai?

Again many thanks for your co-operation
in these matters.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S.I.
According to thing list is still
at same place. Verify.
17/7

英国驻上海总领事馆
上海
1985年7月16日
22 7 45

亲爱的夏曼先生：

兹附上我们收到的一封来自美国缅因州加德纳市沃特街243号伊夫琳·丹福思夫人（Mrs. Evelyn Danforth）的信件副本，信中询问理查德·特伦斯·唐先生（Mr. Terrance Down. Richard）目前的下落。

根据本总领事馆的记录，有一位理查德·特伦斯·唐先生，1999年3月17日出生于英国布里斯托尔，最后于1929年12月5日在此登记。然而，他似乎曾在1938年身处上海，因为有关于其1930至1938年间未注册问题的提及，但他似乎并未进行注册。其最后地址为上海圆明园路8号安得森·梅尔有限公司（Anderson, Meyer & Company, Limited）转交。

能否请您协助查明他是否仍在上海？

再次感谢您在此类事务上的合作。

此致

敬礼

V. 夏曼 先生
助理处长
上海公共租界工部局警务处
上海。

S.I.
根据名录显示其仍在同一地点。核实。
7月17日

6th June, 1941.

British Consulate-General,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sirs,

It was suggested to me that I write to you
in regard to a friend, from whom I have not heard
for some time. The name, Richard Terrance Down, the
Far Eastern Representative for Johnson & Johnson of
Slough, Bucks, England. I had known him for several
years and corresponded with him regularly. Suddenly,
about four years ago all letters ceased.

I received a card saying that he had a letter
half finished and would mail it soon, but I never
heard from him again. I wrote several times but
received no answer. Have written to the office of
Johnson & Johnson, but heard nothing. Because of the
war I do not know if they had an office in Shanghai
any longer.

I would appreciate very much any information
you may be able to give me as to Mr. Down's welfare
and present location if alive.

Thanking you very much,

I am,
Sincerely Yours,

( ) EVELYN DAVPORT

1941年6月6日。

中国上海
英国总领事馆。

尊敬的先生们：

有人建议我就一位朋友的情况致信贵馆，我已有一段时间未收到他的消息。该人名叫理查德·特伦斯·唐（Richard Terrance Down），是英国白金汉郡斯劳市（Slough, Bucks）强生公司（Johnson & Johnson）的远东代表。我认识他已有数年，并定期与他通信。大约四年前，所有信件突然中断。

我收到一张明信片，说他有一封信写了一半，很快会寄出，但我再也没有收到他的消息。我写过几次信，但未收到回复。我曾致信强生公司办公室，但杳无音信。由于战争原因，我不知道他们在上海是否还设有办事处。

如蒙告知唐先生的安危及若在世其目前所在地，我将不胜感激。

非常感谢，

此致

敬礼

（ ）伊夫琳·达文波特（EVELYN DAVPORT）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Sp. Br. REGISTRY
No. N. 9887
Date. 12/ 8 /41

SHANGHAI TIMES.
AUG 9 1941.
BRITISH RESIDENT
IS PENALIZED
Failed To Register In
Consulate; Fined
Forty Dollars

Mr. Richard T. Down was fined
$40 by Registrar C H. Haines in
the British Police Court yesterday
morning when he pleaded guilty to
the two charges of having neglected
to register as a British subject resi-
dent within the Shanghai Consular
District, during 1940 and 1941. Mr.
Down pleaded not guilty to ten
similar charges in respect of the
years 1930 to 1939 inclusive, saying
that he had no fixed abode in Shang-
hai during those years.
Mr. A. T. Cox, appearing for the
Crown, requested an adjournment
of the case to enable him to secure
evidence to show that the defendant
was a resident in Shanghai at inter-
vals between 1930 and 1939. The
case will next be heard on Tuesday.
In the brief hearing yesterday, Mr.
Cox mentioned that the defendant
was owing in arrears for registra-
tion from 1930 to 1938, to the amount
of $87. He also pointed out to the
Court that the name of the defen-
dant was in the hong lists of the
past two years, but Mr. Haines
stated that what was in the directory
was not conclusive evidence. How-
ever, as Mr. Down pleaded guilty
to the last two charges, Mr. Haines
fined him $20 on each charge and
postponed the hearing on the other
charges.

（印：COMMANDER ... AUG. 1941 ... (EXCEPTIONS)）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ... AUG 9 1941 ... SPECIAL BRANCH）

FILE
Mr Cox requested
adjournment re this
matter. St. will
have report ready
by Monday morning
AH

1941年8月9日。
英籍居民
受处罚
未在领事馆登记；罚款
四十美元

理查德·T·唐先生昨天上午在英国巡捕房法庭被登记官 C.H. 海恩斯（C H. Haines）罚款40美元，当时他对两项指控认罪，即作为居住在上海市领事辖区内的英籍臣民，在1940年和1941年期间疏忽登记。唐先生对1930年至1939年（含）期间的十项类似指控表示不认罪，称他在那些年份在上海没有固定住所。
代表控方出庭的 A.T. 考克斯先生（Mr. A. T. Cox）请求延期审理此案，以便他获取证据，证明被告在1930年至1939年期间间歇性地居住在上海。该案将于下周二再次开庭。
在昨天的简短听证中，考克斯先生提到，被告拖欠1930年至1938年的注册费，金额为87美元。他还向法庭指出，被告的名字出现在过去两年的行名簿（hong lists）中，但海恩斯先生表示，目录中的内容并非确凿证据。然而，由于唐先生对最后两项指控认罪，海恩斯先生对每项指控罚款20美元，并推迟了对其他指控的听证。
